_comment: Written by tools/content/build.py: every generated item the build keeps (drill.generator in the built catalogue), as {id, family, version}, sorted by id. Do not edit: a full default build compares this file with what it would write, rewrites it and fails while they differ, so a stale copy fails CI. tools/content/check_chains.py resolves an exercise id by exact match against these rows first, then against generator_continuity.json (FABLE.md section 3).
